claims.text: The car pulls forward out of the dark.
The image shows a black sports car on a showroom floor.
The car has a carbon-fibre body.
The image has a live-action, cinematic look.
A thin band of pale light waits near the front edge of the showroom floor.
A restrained low synthetic pulse underlies the scene and rises slightly as the car emerges.

description.text: At the opening instant, the black sports car rests on the empty showroom floor exactly as framed, its carbon-fibre body catching only thin edge highlights while the surrounding space sinks into darkness.
The floor beneath it is a broad, polished plane, dimly reflective and almost black, with the car's low silhouette anchored near the centre of the composition and the front wheels set straight.
Over the first moments the showroom light falls away, drawing a soft gradient of shadow across the panels and leaving the wheels as dark, precise shapes against the floor.
A thin band of pale light waits near the front edge of the floor, and the car begins to creep toward it at walking pace, the nose held level while the front wheels straighten by a fraction.

Faint highlights slide along the bonnet and down the flank as the body moves, and the surrounding darkness presses closer, making the car seem to emerge from the room itself rather than simply cross it.
The air feels still, the floor gives back only a muted reflection, and every small shift of the body reads clearly against the deepening black.
The car remains stationary at the opening instant, its body half-lost in the dim showroom.
A low room tone rests under the scene and begins to thin toward near silence.
The overhead light falls away, leaving only faint edge highlights along the carbon-fibre panels.
The front wheels straighten slightly and the car eases forward toward the pale band of light.
The car pulls forward out of the shadows, its nose crossing into the hard band of light; the beam sweeps along the bonnet and down the flank, waking the carbon-fibre weave in a cool silver sheen.

As the body clears the darkness, the showroom floor behind it is swallowed by black, and the pale light travels from the front of the car toward the rear, revealing the low, wide stance and the polished wheels one section at a time.

The car advances steadily into the open floor, its movement smooth and deliberate, while the light catches the curve of the roof, the sharp line of the rear haunch, and the dark gaps around the wheel arches.
The tail lights are the last bright detail to leave the shadow, and the empty floor closes over the space behind the car as the blackness returns.
By the final moment, the showroom is once again a dark, reflective void, with the car having passed through the band of illumination and out of the pooled light.
The polished surface holds a faint afterimage of the body, then settles into stillness.
The car's nose breaks into the hard band of light and continues forward.
A soft tyre scuff rolls across the polished floor, joined by a rising low electric hum.
The light sweeps along the bonnet and flank, revealing the carbon-fibre weave and the polished wheels.
The tail lights pass out of the shadow as the empty floor behind the car returns to darkness.

soundscape: Low showroom room tone that thins toward near silence, with a soft tyre scuff and a distant electric hum as the car advances.
music: A restrained low synthetic pulse, almost subliminal, rising slightly as the car emerges and fading with the returning dark.
